headline: Vandana Vaidh files SEBI Regulation 31(4) takeover disclosure for Prozone Realty
sum: Vandana Vaidh has filed a substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations (Regulation 31(4)) with NSE for Prozone Realty Limited. Details of the acquisition percentage, consideration, and deal structure remain unconfirmed pending access to the full disclosure document.
detail: The disclosure was submitted to NSE on or around 29 June 2026 by Vandana Vaidh under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation mandates disclosure when an acquirer crosses the 25% shareholding threshold or acquires additional shares to reach a higher slab. The acquisition value, shareholding percentage acquired, and deal structure have not been corroborated from independent official sources.
